잠깐만요.m: just a moment, wait a second; excuse me (passing through)
잠깐만요.x: Wait a second, I didn't bring my wallet.

오전.forms: 오전이 · 오전을 · before a time: 오전 아홉 시
오전.x: I have Korean class in the morning.
오전.t: 오전/오후 go before the time: 오전 열 시 = 10 a.m.

메뉴.x: Could we have the menu here, please?
메뉴.t: 메뉴 can mean a dish itself; the physical menu card is 메뉴판.

주소.x: Please write your name and address here.

주무시다.x: Grandpa is sleeping in his room now.
주무시다.t: 안녕히 주무세요 = 'Good night' to elders. Never use 주무시다 about yourself.

얼음.ex: 더우니까 음료수에 얼음을 많이 넣어 주세요.
얼음.x: It's hot, so please put lots of ice in my drink.
얼음.e: From 얼다 'to freeze' + -음: literally 'the frozen thing'.
얼음.t: Pronounced [어름]; at cafés, 얼음 많이 'lots of ice' or 얼음 빼고 'no ice' come in handy.

옮기다.m: to move, to carry; to transfer
옮기다.x: Please move this box over there.
옮기다.e: Causative of 옮다 'to shift' or 'to spread' (as a cold does).
옮기다.t: Also for changing places: 회사를 옮기다 = to change jobs.

줄다.forms: 줄어요 · 줄었어요 · 줄 거예요 · 준 (+noun) (ㄹ drops)
줄다.x: The number of students has dropped a lot lately.
줄다.e: Also seen in 줄어들다 'to shrink' and 줄이다 'to reduce'.
줄다.t: Because the ㄹ drops, 줄 거예요 and 준 look like forms of 주다 'to give'.

그만두다.m: to quit, to stop, to give up
그만두다.ex: 일이 너무 힘들어서 회사를 그만두고 싶어요.
그만두다.x: The work is so hard that I want to quit my job.
그만두다.e: Built from 그만 'stop there, that much' + 두다 'to leave as is'.
그만두다.t: Takes an object: 회사를/일을/공부를 그만두다. 그만두세요 can sound like 'Stop it!'

화면.ex: 핸드폰 화면이 깨져서 잘 안 보여요.
화면.x: My phone screen cracked, so it's hard to see.

김치찌개.ex: 저는 돼지고기를 넣은 김치찌개를 제일 좋아해요.
김치찌개.x: I like kimchi stew with pork the most.
김치찌개.e: 김치 + 찌개 'stew'; it tastes best made with sour, well-fermented kimchi.

반말.ex: 우리 이제 많이 친하니까 반말로 이야기할까요?
반말.x: We're pretty close now, so shall we talk casually?
반말.e: Literally 'half speech' — sentences cut short without the polite ending.
반말.t: Don't switch to 반말 with older people or new acquaintances until they suggest it — it can sound rude.

부모.x: I think parents' love is truly great.
부모.t: When talking about your own or someone else's parents, say 부모님; bare 부모 sounds general or impersonal.

텐트.x: As soon as we got to the campsite, we pitched the tent.
텐트.t: Pitch a tent: 텐트를 치다. This 치다 is the one for putting up or hanging something (as in 커튼을 치다), not 'to hit'. Taking it down is 텐트를 걷다.

미터.x: This swimming pool is 50 meters long.
미터.t: Use Sino-Korean numbers with it: 오십 미터, not 쉰 미터.

진찰하다.x: The doctor examined the patient carefully.

제사.m: ancestral rite, memorial service for ancestors
제사.x: My family holds an ancestral rite every major holiday.
제사.e: Literally 'offering and worship': food is set out for ancestors' spirits.
제사.t: The verb used is 지내다: 제사를 지내다 (to hold an ancestral rite).

줄어들다.forms: 줄어들어요 · 줄어들었어요 · 줄어들 거예요 · 줄어드는 (+noun) (ㄹ drops)
줄어들다.m: to decrease, to shrink, to diminish
줄어들다.ex: 시골에 사는 젊은 사람이 점점 줄어들고 있어요.
줄어들다.x: The number of young people living in the countryside is gradually shrinking.
줄어들다.e: 줄다 (to decrease) + 들다 (to go in): shrinking inward.

관련.ex: 요즘 환경과 관련이 있는 책을 읽고 있어요.
관련.x: These days I'm reading books related to the environment.
관련.t: Pronounced [괄련]: ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

현실.x: Dreams and reality are often different.

발견.x: This medicine was made through an accidental discovery.

화해.ex: 우리는 싸운 다음 날 바로 화해를 했어요.
화해.x: We made up the very next day after our fight.
화해.e: Literally 'harmonize and untie' the knot between people.

매진.ex: 콘서트 표가 오 분 만에 매진됐어요.
매진.x: The concert tickets sold out in five minutes.
매진.t: Used as 매진되다: 표가 매진됐어요 'the tickets sold out'. 매진 임박 = almost sold out.

어학당.ex: 저는 서울에 있는 어학당에서 한국어를 배워요.
어학당.x: I'm learning Korean at a university language institute in Seoul.
어학당.e: 어학 'language study' + 당 'hall': literally 'language study hall'.
어학당.t: Pronounced [어학땅]: ㄷ becomes tense after ㄱ. Most major universities run one, with terms of about ten weeks.

발사.x: The rocket launch was postponed because of the weather.

고갈.x: When oil runs out, we'll need other energy.
고갈.t: Usually used as 고갈되다 with resources, water or even energy: 체력이 고갈됐어요.

종량제.ex: 종량제 봉투는 편의점에서 살 수 있어요.
종량제.x: You can buy official trash bags at a convenience store.
종량제.e: Literally 'pay-by-amount system'; you pay by buying official trash bags.
종량제.t: Pronounced [종냥제]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ after the ㅇ batchim.

의욕적.ex: 새 팀장님은 일을 아주 의욕적으로 시작했어요.
의욕적.x: The new team leader started the job with a lot of drive.

우회하다.m: to take a detour, to go around; to bypass
우회하다.x: There was an accident, so we took a detour.
우회하다.t: Also used figuratively: 우회적으로 말하다 'to say something indirectly.'

신청곡.x: If you have any song requests, please let me know.
신청곡.t: Radio DJs and buskers often ask 신청곡 있으세요? 'Any requests?'

참조.x: I sent the email with the team leader cc'd too.
참조.t: In Korean email apps the cc field is labelled 참조, and bcc is 숨은 참조 'hidden cc'. In documents it means 'see': 3쪽 참조 'see page 3'.

주권.x: The sovereignty of the Republic of Korea rests with the people.
주권.t: Pronounced [주꿘] — the ㄱ in 권 becomes tense.

자본.ex: 새 사업을 시작하려면 자본이 많이 필요해요.
자본.x: You need a lot of capital to start a new business.
자본.e: Literally 'base resources' — the money a business starts from.

설전.m: war of words, heated verbal dispute
설전.ex: 두 후보는 토론회에서 뜨거운 설전을 벌였어요.
설전.x: The two candidates had a heated war of words at the debate.
설전.t: Pronounced [설쩐] — tensification after ㄹ in Sino-Korean words.

제재.ex: 유엔은 그 나라에 대한 경제 제재를 강화했습니다.
제재.x: The UN tightened economic sanctions on that country.
제재.e: Literally 'control and judge' — punishing to restrain behavior.
제재.t: Collocations: 제재를 가하다 (impose), 제재를 받다 (be sanctioned), 제재를 풀다 (lift).

서사.ex: 이 영화는 서사가 탄탄해서 끝까지 몰입하게 돼요.
서사.x: This movie has a solid narrative, so you stay absorbed until the end.
서사.t: Fans often praise a drama's 서사 to mean its backstory or character arc.

토로하다.m: to pour out (one's feelings), to voice, to vent
토로하다.ex: 그는 회의에서 그동안 쌓인 불만을 솔직하게 토로했어요.
토로하다.x: At the meeting, he frankly voiced the frustrations that had built up.
토로하다.e: Literally 'spit out and expose' — letting hidden feelings come out.
토로하다.t: Usually takes feelings as object: 심경을 토로하다, 불만을 토로하다, 고충을 토로하다.

움츠리다.m: to shrink back, to hunch up, to flinch; to be cowed
움츠리다.ex: 찬 바람에 사람들이 어깨를 움츠리고 걸어갔어요.
움츠리다.x: People walked with their shoulders hunched against the cold wind.
움츠리다.e: Sounds like 움찔 'with a flinch' — both describe pulling the body in.

면밀하다.t: Common pattern: 면밀히 검토하다, 면밀히 조사하다.

개방적.e: -적 = '-ic, -al': turns a noun into a describing word, e.g. 개방적, 보수적.

일방적으로.x: The company canceled the contract unilaterally.
일방적으로.t: 일방적으로 통보하다 'to notify one-sidedly' is a frequent complaint in news and workplaces.

불확실성.x: As economic uncertainty grew, consumer spending fell.

권태.ex: 매일 같은 일을 하다 보니 권태를 느끼게 되었어요.
권태.x: Doing the same thing every day, I started to feel weary of it.
권태.t: Couples talk about 권태기, the stage when a relationship feels stale and routine.

역학 조사.ex: 보건 당국은 확진자의 동선에 대해 역학 조사를 했어요.
역학 조사.x: Health authorities carried out an epidemiological investigation into the confirmed patient's movements.
역학 조사.t: 역학 is pronounced [여칵]; a different 역학 means 'mechanics' in physics.

이관하다.ex: 그 업무는 다음 달부터 다른 부서로 이관합니다.
이관하다.x: That task will be transferred to another department starting next month.

신예.ex: 그 영화는 신예 감독의 첫 작품입니다.
신예.x: That film is the first work of an up-and-coming director.
신예.t: 신예 stresses talent and promise, while 신인 just means a newcomer.

몰수.ex: 법원은 범죄로 얻은 재산을 모두 몰수했습니다.
몰수.x: The court confiscated all the assets gained through the crime.
몰수.e: Literally 'take away and collect' — the state takes the property for good.
몰수.t: 압수 is a temporary seizure during an investigation; 몰수 is permanent forfeiture by judgment.

염좌.x: An ankle sprain is a common injury for athletes.
염좌.e: Literally 'twist and wrench' — the medical word for a sprain.
염좌.t: 염좌 is formal and medical; in daily life people say 발목을 삐었어요 (I sprained my ankle).

사이버폭력.ex: 악성 댓글 같은 사이버폭력은 심각한 범죄입니다.
사이버폭력.x: Cyberbullying such as malicious comments is a serious crime.

생태통로.ex: 고속도로 위에 동물들을 위한 생태통로를 만들었습니다.
생태통로.x: A wildlife crossing for animals was built over the highway.
생태통로.t: Pronounced [생태통노]: ㄹ after ㅇ turns into ㄴ.

진두지휘하다.m: to lead from the front, to personally take command
진두지휘하다.ex: 사장이 직접 현장에서 복구 작업을 진두지휘했습니다.
진두지휘하다.x: The CEO personally led the recovery work on site.
진두지휘하다.e: Literally 'directing from the head of the battle line'.

우람하다.ex: 그 선수는 어깨가 우람하고 키도 아주 커요.
우람하다.x: That athlete has massive shoulders and is very tall, too.

은근하다.m: subtle, quiet, understated; warm in a low-key way
은근하다.ex: 그 사람은 말은 없지만 정이 은근해요.
은근하다.x: He doesn't talk much, but he's quietly warm-hearted.
은근하다.e: From hanja meaning 'earnest, attentive'; now 'quiet and understated'.
은근하다.t: The adverb 은근히 is very common in speech: 은근히 기대돼요 'I'm secretly looking forward to it.'

요체.x: The heart of this policy is job creation.
